prose.en: Tori breaks uke's balance forward, steps the left foot in deeply between uke's feet, and, falling straight backwards, places the sole of the right foot against uke's lower abdomen and pulls with both hands, throwing uke over tori's own body.

Image of the technique and the ukemi (breakfall). Uke's cooperation: Uke takes mae-mawari-ukemi (forward rolling breakfall), using tori's right foot as a support. Tori breaks uke's balance to the front, places the right foot against uke's lower abdomen, and throws while sacrificing the body straight backwards.

heading.en: Introductory way of applying the technique

prose.en: Uke takes mae-mawari-ukemi of his own accord, using tori's right foot as the pivot point.
Tori places the sole of the right foot against uke's lower abdomen, lifts uke up and holds the balance.
Apply tomoe-nage when uke comes forward.

heading.en: Faults that are easy to fall into

prose.en: Tori should keep the left foot from leaving the tatami.
